paper_statement: Each track is represented by a unified V4 record containing track_id, culture, embedding, optional affect_label, and optional source_dataset.
Training batches contain x, culture, track_index, affect_label, and source_label tensors.
The downstream model factorizes each input embedding into zc, zs, and za latent variables.
The base objective combines reconstruction, KL, domain-adversarial, contrastive, covariance, total-correlation, HSIC, affect, and source terms.
Pairwise constraint supervision is added through a margin-based auxiliary loss on za.
Ranking supervision is activated later through a separate auxiliary loss over rank examples built from interactions.
Constraint and ranking losses are not active from epoch 1; they are stage-activated through curriculum scales.
Source-balanced sampling and source-adversarial supervision are used to mitigate culture-source confounding.
Calibration-aware reranking acts as a controllable inference-time trade-off layer rather than a purely fixed post-processing rule.
The PAL pipeline is execution-ready and turns uncertainty-ranked pairs into annotation packets and retraining constraints.
